title: Aye maula Raza shahe khurasan
body:
Aye maula Raza shahe khurasan
Ya Imam E Reza (A.S.)..8
Aai Garibul Guraba (A.s.) , Aai Moinaz Zoefa (A.s.) , Tujh pe Qaunain Fida, Aai Ali Moosa Reza (A.s.), Aai Ali Ali Ali Moosa Reza (A.s.)  Jaan, Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
Yeh Jaan Hai Kya.. Dono Jahan Aap Pe Qurban
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jub Koi Thikana Nahi Milta Hai Jahan Me
Aajate Hai Woh Aap Ke Daaman E Ama Me
Haiwan Ho Chahe Woh Parinde Ho Ya Insan
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
Naubat Yahi Kehti Hai Ke Aane Ko Hai Naubat
Hone Ko Hai Qaiyam Tere Qaiyam (A.t.f.s.) Ki Hukumat
Mashad Me Yehi Sham O Sahar Hota Hai Ailan
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai Mulk E Sakhawat Ke Shahenshan E Sakhawat
Maine Tere Darbar Se Maangi Hai Vizarat
Kya Shan Hai Wallah Mohammad (S.a.w.w.)  Ke Wali Ki
Masroof  Mila Mujhko  Woh  Midhat Me Ali (A.s.) Ki, Haan Mai Ne Uthaya Tere Rauze Pe Jo Quran
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sub Ne Jo Khorashan Ke Raste Me Suna Hai
Tu Ne (A.s.) Tere Baba (A.s.)  Ne Tere Jad (A.s.) Ne Kaha Hai
Hum Sub Ke Sabab Kalma E Tawheed Me Hai Jaan
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan.2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behlool Ki Maroof Ki (A)buzar Ki Kasam Hai
Malik Tujhe Bus Malik E Ashtar Ki Kasam Hai
Pal Bhar Me Mujhe Banade Salman Ka Salman
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
De Midhat e Ajdad Ka Aaka Mujhe Yu Fal
Jistarha Se Kehlata Hai Shair Tera Debal
Kehlane Lage Meer Bhi Yun Tera Sana Khwan
<<MINI>>
Aai Maula Raza (A.s.) Maula Raza (A.s.) Shah E Khorashan..2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Imam E Raza (A.s.)..8
